name: 音声入力付き検索欄
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Correct ONE component only: LH01-0001 音声入力付き検索欄. Input image1 is the generated candidate to correct. Input image2 is the original saved Japanese mock and exact typography/proportion reference. Input image3 is the approved surface/style reference only.
Make just one targeted correction: reduce the visible weight of the Japanese placeholder and the outline icons to match the delicate regular strokes of image2. Current candidate text looks semibold and icons too heavy. Use Meiryo Regular14/24, tracking0 at a logical390px component width, uniformly scaled. Do not use semibold or bold. Match the original mock's text-size-to-control-height ratio.
Keep the exact single-line text "地域や施設を検索", left back chevron, right microphone, empty/unfocused state, white capsule, subtle neutral border, slate #526173 icons, pure white outer canvas, faint downward shadow, existing layout and all other content. No colored accent: neutral utility controls, no selected state. Do not add a search button, title, keyboard, results, wordmarks, extra icons or features. One flat frontal isolated search component on a wide3:1 white canvas.
reviewNotes: 実画像を比較し文字とアイコン線の太さを軽減。地域や施設を検索、戻る、音声入力、空欄の状態を保持。対象の原参照に選択アクセントがないため色は追加せず補助アイコンはスレート。白面・輪郭・余白・1行・欠けなしを視認。エージェントによる静止画像レビューでありフォントバイナリ一致、所有者承認、編集可能性、操作、実装の証明ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
